summary: Feature implemented in the repository, nothing committed and no tests or linters run (read-only verification only). Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver). Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Rewrote SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler as thin adapters over those savers and the plot function; ClassificationSaver registers an engine-accepting wrapper for completion. Changed write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. Renamed output_path to output_dir in tests/integration_sliding_window.py and two segmentation_3d evaluation examples. Updated tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename, and added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Manual style checks passed (line length, whitespace, final newline, unused imports). Not verified: the test suite, flake8, and ignite 0.3.0 attach with the wrapper. Sphinx .rst files were not updated for the new modules.
